ActionDescriptions.ToRunUserSecretCollectorInteractiveSite:
to securely collect a token from the user
Launches a blocking browser popup that asks the user to enter or update one sensitive secret value, such as an API key, private key, password, OAuth token, bearer token, or connection secret. The value is saved directly to UserSecrets secure storage. The model and timeline receive only non-secret confirmation such as status and key name; the secret value is never returned. timeoutSeconds - maximum seconds to wait for browser exit. secretKey - required logical UserSecrets name to prefill as an editable default in the collector.
